ACME CORPORATION — PERFORMANCE REVIEW POLICY
Document ID: HR-PRF-2025-001 | Effective: January 1, 2025

REVIEW FREQUENCY
Performance reviews are conducted annually in Q4 (October through December).
Annual performance reviews occur every year during Q4.
Mid-year check-ins are mandatory in Q2 for all employees.

REVIEW COMPONENTS
Self-assessment: 20%. Manager evaluation: 60%. Peer feedback: 20%.

RATING SCALE
Exceeds Expectations: consistently surpasses goals.
Meets Expectations: delivers on all core responsibilities.
Needs Improvement: requires a Performance Improvement Plan.

OUTCOMES
Ratings inform merit increases, promotions, and development planning.
Promotion nominations accepted during Q4 review cycle only.
Minimum time in role before promotion consideration: 18 months.

CONTACT: hr@acme-corp.com | Performance portal: Workday
